Junior Software Developer
ID
2026-3786
Job Locations
 US-IL-Scott AFB Category Information Technology Type Regular Full-Time
Overview

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking a Junior Software Developer to support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of mission-critical software applications while working alongside experienced developers and technical teams.

 

This position is hybrid and requires on-site support at Scott AFB, IL.

Duties & Responsibilities
Write clean, maintainable code using object-oriented design patterns and SOLID principles.
Participate in code reviews, both submitting work for review and reviewing others' code.
Support and maintain legacy .NET Framework applications under the direction of seniors.
Contribute to scoped portions of the application design process.
Assist in triaging production issues alongside senior developers and DevOps.
Document assigned work and communicate status clearly to a cross-functional development team.
Build working knowledge of the program's technology stack and the Agile process.
Stay current on programming techniques and software technologies.
Qualifications
Active Secret clearance (required).
0–2 years of relevant programming/software development experience.
Obtain Security+ certification within 60 days of hire date (required).
Desired Skills:
Exposure to cloud environments (AWS EC2).
Experience working on a GIS application.
Experience with Oracle.
Experience developing in Java.
Familiarity with basic server administration tasks.
Familiarity with Information Assurance (IA) and QA.
Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.
